It incorrectly identifies Germaine of Foix's paternal grandfather as **Gaston I de Foix-Béarn** (d. 1343). Based on the correct lineage established in previous steps (Germaine's father is John of Foix, Viscount of Narbonne, who was born c. 1450), her paternal grandfather is **Gaston II, Count of Foix** (d. 1472), not Gaston I. Gaston I lived over a century before John of Foix was born. Consequently, the Planner's instructions to search for "Gaston I de Foix-Béarn father of Gaston II" and conclude that he is the answer will lead the team down the wrong path and produce an incorrect solution. The Planner should have recognized that Gaston II (the father of John) is the grandfather of Germaine, not Gaston I (the father of Gaston II).
